title: backlog.py claim is refused in a checkout whose git dir cannot be written, since ledger_lock refuses any OSError, where it claimed without a ledger record before
goal: claim in a checkout whose git dir is not writable claims the item as before the ledger lock, with a warning that the claims ledger was not recorded, so ledger_lock's OSError on creating the lock file no longer refuses the claim itself

run:
import json,os,stat,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,pathlib as P
T=os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py");r=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());g=lambda *a:s.run(["git","-C",str(r),*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
g("init","-q");(r/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items"}));(r/"items").mkdir()
(r/"items"/"ST-aaaaaaaa.json").write_text(json.dumps({"id":"ST-aaaaaaaa","kind":"story","title":"t","status":"todo","priority":"P3","goal":"g","touches":["x.txt"],"checks":[{"run":["python3","-c","pass"]}]},indent=2)+"\n")
g("add","-A");g("-c","user.name=x","-c","user.email=x@x","commit","-qm","i")
gd=P.Path(g("rev-parse","--absolute-git-dir"));m=gd.stat().st_mode;os.chmod(gd,0o555)
env=dict(os.environ,CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID="chk");env.pop("KB_BACKLOG_CONFIG",None)
try:p=s.run([sys.executable,T,"--root",str(r),"claim","ST-aaaaaaaa","--by","w"],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env)
finally:os.chmod(gd,m)
print("claim with an unwritable git dir: exit",p.returncode,(p.stdout+p.stderr)[-200:]);sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==0 else 1)

notes: SP-z3hyk4eh review gap 5 (S4), on ST-zqbo7xgc: _tools/bl_items.py:222 takes ledger_lock, which raises Refused for a non-FileExistsError OSError; the old write's 'except OSError: pass' let the claim through. Repro (planted repo, git dir mode 0555) fails on origin/main f105ef2e4 with Errno 13 on the .lock file.
